name: New Asia Construction & Development Corp.
summary: New Asia Construction & Development Corp., together with its subsidiaries, provides public construction services for governments in Taiwan. The company heavy machinery contracting for civil engineering, land and community development business, and construction National residential and commercial buildings and their leasing and sales business, repair and leasing of heavy machinery, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt concrete Manufacturing and Sales and Investment Business. It also engages in the real estate development and construction businesses. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
